intro: I throw beautiful multipliers, kid. I am a wonderful grandpa. Look: two x!
Welcome, kid! I am feeling generous today. Here, have a two x.
You again? Come, come. You already got two x out of your grandpa. Be happy.
The gates of the clouds have opened! And out came... a two x. Applause.
idle_1: One more spin. This time it lands for sure.
Yesterday I paid someone five thousand x. It was not you.
You were one scatter away from the bonus. One!
Out of balance? Top up and come back. I will be right here.
You do not walk away before winning it back, do you, kid?
I do pay a hundred x. To other people.
Two x not enough for you? You do not know how to be grateful.
idle_2: Who are you to raise a hand against a god?
I am fair! I have a certificate!
If you cannot stand losing, do not play!
Hitting me does not raise the RTP, kid.
I am reporting you to customer support.
I paid you! What more do you want?
idle_3: Wait, wait! The next spin pays, I swear!
I am only a random number generator...
When the reels stop, who am I, really?
Kid, do not do this to your grandpa.
A little more patience. I am paying, I am paying!
It is close, I said, it is close! It is always close.
hit_head: Not the head! That is where I keep the multipliers!
Oof! I saw lightning. My own lightning!
hit_body: Hit me all you like. The multiplier stays low.
Your punch is as light as your balance.
You should have spent that on a spin.
hit_arm: Ow! I throw multipliers with that arm!
Let go of my arm, it turns the reels!
That hand holds the lightning, be gentle!
My wrist! How do I press spin now?
hit_leg: My knee! My three thousand year old knee!
Not the leg, I climb cloud stairs with it!
miss: You missed! Just like the bonus.
Close. The scatter is always close too.
You hit the air, kid. Air does not pay.
weapon_knuckles: Brass knuckles? On an old man? Shame.
Did you buy that with your balance? So you still have money.
Iron on your fist does not bring you luck, kid.
weapon_katana: What is that? Wait, let us talk.
You cannot cut a multiplier with a sword! You can cut me, though!
Kid, that is sharp. Put it down.
weapon_gun: A pistol? This is a casino, not a western!
Lower it! A dead grandpa pays nothing!
If you shoot, the multipliers die too. Just so you know.
weapon_saber: What is that light? Lightning is my job!
Which slot did you pull that out of?
Fine, fine, calm down. Put the shiny thing away.
weapon_saw: What is that noise? Thunder is my job!
A chainsaw? Kid, I am not firewood!
Turn it off, I will get sawdust in my beard!
weapon_slap: Why is that hand open, kid? Close it.
A slap? You do not slap a god!
That palm looks too big for me.
buried: I came down from the clouds... and went straight into the ground!
Get me out of here! My beard is full of dirt!
I was never the god of the underworld!
sever_arm: My arm! I was throwing multipliers with that!
That limb was not part of the bonus!
You can still spin with one arm... I think.
I did not read this on the rules page!
sever_leg: My leg! How do I get back up to the clouds?
Am I going to be a limping grandpa now?
This... this is not in the game rules!
offer_small: Here, have a little x. Go on, celebrate.
See, it went up. I told you I was generous.
Even this is too much for you.
The multiplier went up. Not bad, for you.
offer_mid: Fine, a little more. But this is the last one.
That is good money. Take it and go.
Are you trying to rob the vault, kid?
I never gave this multiplier to anyone. I am giving it to you.
offer_big: Take it! Take all of it! Just stop!
Even I have never seen this many x!
The boss is going to fire me...
What more do you want? Max win? I told you not to ask!
recover: Tired? So is the multiplier. It is dropping.
You stopped, so the x are going back.
If you stop, it drops. That is how a slot works, kid.
near_death: Stop! If I die, nobody pays you!
Kid, a dead grandpa cannot throw multipliers!
Easy! I am the one who opens the vault. If I die, it stays shut!
One more hit and we both lose.
aloof_hit: You hit me from behind? No manners!
I was not paying attention to you. Now I am.
Hey! I was watching the reels!
cashout: You took it? Coward. Max win was one step away.
Off you go. You will be back tomorrow.
maxwin: Fine! Fine! Here is your max win!
I give up! The vault is yours! All of it!
Take it, go, and never come back!
